sloka: दृश्यते ऽसौ महान् सीते सविद्युदिव तोयदः ।ऋश्यमूको गिरिश्रेष्ठः काञ्चनैर्धातुभिर्वृतः ।। ६.१२६.३४ ।।
transliteration: dṛśyate 'sau mahān sīte savidyudiva toyadaḥ ।ṛśyamūko giriśreṣṭhaḥ kāñcanairdhātubhirvṛtaḥ ।। 6.126.34 ।।

translations.english: "You hasten the wives of the monkeys. Taking all of them we shall depart to Ayodhya and shall see the consorts of Dasharatha."
